# Power levels (SPEC 36), Tech, Architect: every power that casts at levels 1, 3 and 5, from the front at the release and
# from behind a few ticks on, at a quarter speed. Generated by tools/qa/power_level_tours.py: edit that, not this.
# Look tour: tools/tour-ci.sh tools/autopilot/power-levels-d.txt 2400 PACK=feel
world powerlevelsd survival 4262
waitworld
wait 60
cmd awaken opening skip
wait 40
window 1440 900
gui 0
hud off
cmd gamerule awaken:fauna_spawning false
cmd gamerule show_advancement_messages false
cmd gamerule send_command_feedback false
cmd gamerule spawn_mobs false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
cmd gamerule fall_damage false
cmd weather clear 100000
cmd time set 5000
cmd awaken admin awaken
wait 200
cmd awaken powers starter 1
wait 20
screen close
cmd effect give @s minecraft:saturation 100000 10 true
cmd effect give @s minecraft:resistance 100000 4 true
cmd effect give @s minecraft:slow_falling 60 1 true
cmd tp @s 0.5 201 0.5 0 12
wait 400
cmd fill -14 199 -6 14 199 30 minecraft:smooth_stone
cmd fill -14 200 -6 14 214 30 minecraft:air
cmd fill -14 200 22 14 210 22 minecraft:deepslate_tiles
wait 40

# ---- Wall 1
cmd tp @e[type=minecraft:husk] 0.5 120 0.5
cmd kill @e[type=minecraft:husk]
cmd fill -14 200 -6 14 214 21 minecraft:air
cmd fill -14 199 -6 14 199 30 minecraft:smooth_stone
cmd tp @s 0.5 200 0.5 0 0
cmd summon minecraft:husk 1.2 200 1.9 {NoAI:1b,PersistenceRequired:1b,Rotation:[180f,0f],Health:200f,attributes:[{id:"minecraft:max_health",base:200d}]}
cmd summon minecraft:husk -0.6 200 7.5 {NoAI:1b,PersistenceRequired:1b,Rotation:[180f,0f],Health:200f,attributes:[{id:"minecraft:max_health",base:200d}]}
cmd summon minecraft:husk 2.5 200 11.5 {NoAI:1b,PersistenceRequired:1b,Rotation:[180f,0f],Health:200f,attributes:[{id:"minecraft:max_health",base:200d}]}
cmd awaken admin power showcase wall 1
camera front
look 0 10
wait 14
cmd tick rate 5
wait 2
cmd awaken admin power cast wall
wait 3
shotnow pl_wall_1_front
camera back
wait 3
shotnow pl_wall_1_back
cmd tick rate 20
wait 30

cmd summon minecraft:husk 2.5 200 11.5 {NoAI:1b,PersistenceRequired:1b,Rotation:[180f,0f],Health:200f,attributes:[{id:"minecraft:max_health",base:200d}]}

cmd summon minecraft:husk 1.2 200 1.9 {NoAI:1b,PersistenceRequired:1b,Rotation:[180f,0f],Health:200f,attributes:[{id:"minecraft:max_health",base:200d}]}
cmd summon minecraft:husk -0.6 200 7.5 {NoAI:1b,PersistenceRequired:1b,Rotation:[180f,0f],Health:200f,attributes:[{id:"minecraft:max_health",base:200d}]}
cmd summon minecraft:husk 2.5 200 11.5 {NoAI:1b,PersistenceRequired:1b,Rotation:[180f,0f],Health:200f,attributes:[{id:"minecraft:max_health",base:200d}]}
cmd awaken admin power showcase drone_swarm 3
camera front
look 0 10
wait 14
cmd tick rate 5
wait 2
cmd awaken admin power cast drone_swarm
wait 1
shotnow pl_drone_swarm_3_front
camera back
wait 3
shotnow pl_drone_swarm_3_back
cmd tick rate 20
wait 30

# ---- Drone Swarm 5
cmd tp @e[type=minecraft:husk] 0.5 120 0.5
cmd kill @e[type=minecraft:husk]
cmd fill -14 200 -6 14 214 21 minecraft:air
cmd fill -14 199 -6 14 199 30 minecraft:smooth_stone
cmd tp @s 0.5 200 0.5 0 0
cmd summon minecraft:husk 1.2 200 1.9 {NoAI:1b,PersistenceRequired:1b,Rotation:[180f,0f],Health:200f,attributes:[{id:"minecraft:max_health",base:200d}]}
cmd summon minecraft:husk -0.6 200 7.5 {NoAI:1b,PersistenceRequired:1b,Rotation:[180f,0f],Health:200f,attributes:[{id:"minecraft:max_health",base:200d}]}
cmd summon minecraft:husk 2.5 200 11.5 {NoAI:1b,PersistenceRequired:1b,Rotation:[180f,0f],Health:200f,attributes:[{id:"minecraft:max_health",base:200d}]}
cmd awaken admin power showcase drone_swarm 5
camera front
look 0 10
wait 14
cmd tick rate 5
wait 2
cmd awaken admin power cast drone_swarm
wait 1
shotnow pl_drone_swarm_5_front
camera back
wait 3
shotnow pl_drone_swarm_5_back
cmd tick rate 20
wait 30

# ---- the HUD's tier frames at level 5
cmd tp @e[type=minecraft:husk] 0.5 120 0.5
cmd kill @e[type=minecraft:husk]
cmd fill -14 200 -6 14 214 21 minecraft:air
cmd fill -14 199 -6 14 199 30 minecraft:smooth_stone
cmd tp @s 0.5 200 0.5 0 0
cmd summon minecraft:husk 1.2 200 1.9 {NoAI:1b,PersistenceRequired:1b,Rotation:[180f,0f],Health:200f,attributes:[{id:"minecraft:max_health",base:200d}]}
cmd summon minecraft:husk -0.6 200 7.5 {NoAI:1b,PersistenceRequired:1b,Rotation:[180f,0f],Health:200f,attributes:[{id:"minecraft:max_health",base:200d}]}
cmd summon minecraft:husk 2.5 200 11.5 {NoAI:1b,PersistenceRequired:1b,Rotation:[180f,0f],Health:200f,attributes:[{id:"minecraft:max_health",base:200d}]}
cmd awaken admin power showcase wall 5
cmd awaken admin power showcase citadel 5
cmd awaken admin power showcase grapple 5
camera back
look 0 10
hud on
wait 20
shot pl_hud_d
hud off

quit
